• The word **"Exestenalism"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Existentialism"**. (अस्तित्ववाद)

 
 
• **Example: **Jean-Paul Sartre is one of the most well-known philosophers of **existentialism.**
 
 
 
• **"Existentialism"** is a philosophical theory or approach that emphasizes the existence of the individual person as a free and responsible agent determining their own development through acts of the will. (अस्तित्ववाद)
 
 
• **Example: Existentialism **explores themes such as the meaning of life and the concept of free will.

• **Assimilation** (अवशोषण): The process of taking in and fully understanding information or ideas.

 
 
• **Example: **Assimilation of different cultures can enrich a society.
 
 
 
• **Pluckiness** (साहस): The quality of being brave and determined.
 
 
• **Example: **Her pluckiness in the face of adversity was truly inspiring.
 
 
 
• **Accumulation** (संचय): The acquisition or gradual gathering of something.
